title: Master Account, Direct Billing and Rate Inclusions under Group Room Blocks
content:
Four Group Room Blocks terms govern billing and what the group rate contains: whether room charges may be billed to a group master account, whether the master account may be settled by invoice after the event (direct billing), the calendar days after the invoice within which the master account is due, and whether the group rate includes breakfast.

| Block type | Room charges may be billed to a group master account | Master account may be settled by invoice after the event | Master account due (calendar days after the invoice) | Group rate includes breakfast |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Social Event Room Block | No | No | 30 | No |
| Wedding Room Block | Yes | No | 30 | No |
| Sports Team Room Block | Yes | No | 30 | Yes |
| Tour & Travel Series Block | Yes | Yes | 30 | Yes |
| Corporate Meeting Room Block | Yes | Yes | 30 | No |
| Association Convention Room Block | Yes | Yes | 30 | No |

### Notes to the schedule

- Direct billing is open only on the three block types marked Yes in the invoice column: Tour & Travel Series Block, Corporate Meeting Room Block and Association Convention Room Block.
- The payment term of 30 calendar days is the same on every block type.
- Breakfast is built into the group rate on two block types: Sports Team Room Block and Tour & Travel Series Block.

### Reading the columns together (hypothetical invoice)

On a Corporate Meeting Room Block whose master account is invoiced after the event, the balance is due within 30 calendar days of the invoice date. A Social Event Room Block shows No in the master-account column, so room charges are not billed to a group master account on that block type.
